## author questions

- **q.plant_model** (open): Which published model (and code) is the SEA-DBS environment: the Kumaravelu, Brocker & Grill 2016 basal ganglia model as used by Mehregan et al. 2024, or another one? What did you change (populations, neurons per population, PD condition, DBS pulse amplitude and width, integrator), and what does the environment seed control?
  - why it matters: The paper names no plant paper besides Mehregan et al., and says both 'ten neurons per population' and 'the basal ganglia consist of 10 neurons'. Without the plant we can't rebuild any result.
  - about: plant.model (§III; §V-A), plant.neurons_per_population (§III; §V-A), plant.synapses (§III), plant.equations (§III), plant.pd_condition (§III; §V-A), plant.dbs_pulse (§III; §IV-A), plant.integrator (§V-A), plant.reset (Alg. 1 line 3), plant.seed (§V-B)
- **q.beta_computation** (open): How is P_beta computed each 2 ms step: which PSD estimator, on what signal (spike times, binned spikes, voltage), over how long a window, and how is it scaled so that the 0.35 threshold applies? What is n_obs, and do the networks take the n_obs-long window or the mean P̄_beta?
  - why it matters: Sets the observation and the reward. Fig. 4a plots PSD x 10^-3 while Table II reports PSD around 300, and Table II's rewards match Eq. (7) at PSD/1000.
  - about: obs.psd_method (§III; §V-A), obs.psd_window (§III; §V-A), obs.scale (Eq. (7); Fig. 2; Fig. 4a; Table II), obs.n_obs (§IV-A, Eq. (4)), obs.network_input (§IV-A, Eq. (4)-(5); §V-A), reward.timing (Alg. 1 line 8)
- **q.stimulation** (open): How does the binary action relate to the 50 Hz and 30 Hz stimulation frequencies in Fig. 5-6: does a_t = 1 turn on a pulse train at that frequency, or gate single pulses? Which frequency was used in training, and which in Fig. 7 and Table II?
  - why it matters: Decides what an action does in the plant and which condition each result panel uses.
  - about: action.stim_frequency (§V-B; Fig. 5; Fig. 6), plant.dbs_pulse (§III; §IV-A)
- **q.networks** (open): What are the actor, critic and predictive-model architectures (layers, widths, activations), how many logits does the actor output, and is the predictive model f_theta a separate network from the actor? Which networks does the 65 MB / 33 MB model size count?
  - why it matters: No architecture is given; 65 MB is large for a scalar or short-window input, so the size claim can't be checked without it.

- **q.gumbel_and_updates** (open): What are tau_0, tau_min and lambda_tau, and is t in Eq. (14) the step within an episode or a global counter? Is the Gumbel noise applied once (softmax of Eq. Does the target use the stored r̂_t or a fresh prediction? What are the soft-update rate, optimizer, predictive-model learning rate, warm-up and terminal handling?

(9); Alg. 1 lines 17-19), train.soft_update_rate (Alg. 1; Table I), train.optimizer (§V-A; Table I), train.pred_lr (Table I), algo.warmup (Alg. 1 lines 11-12), algo.terminal (Eq. (7) of the mean PSD)? For Fig. 4-7: how many seeds, which checkpoint, is a test 'step' one 2 ms env step, are actions sampled or greedy at test time, and how was FP16 PTQ applied?
